verdict.rationale: Kong offers some natural-language-driven features—Insomnia's AI-assisted mock server generation from prompts and AI commit-message suggestions—and Konnect exposes an official MCP server that would let an AI agent operate Kong via natural-language client commands. However, there's no direct evidence of natural-language control over core Kong Gateway operations (routes, services, plugins) themselves, only through auxiliary tools (Insomnia) or via a separate MCP integration layer. Missing for 10: first-party docs showing NL commands operating Kong Gateway/Konnect admin functions directly, and independent hands-on verification of the MCP-driven NL workflow.
